mapper.select: SELECT VIRTUAL_ACCOUNT_ID AS virtualAccountId, ACCOUNT_TYPE AS accountType, ACCOUNT_NUMBER AS accountNumber, BANK_CODE AS bankCode, CUSTOMER_NAME AS customerName, DUE_DATE AS dueDate, EXPIRED AS expired, SETTLEMENT_STATUS AS settlementStatus, SECRET AS secret, MBR_CD AS mbrCd, VIRTUAL_ACCOUNT_AMOUNT AS virtualAccountAmount FROM VIRTUAL_ACCOUNT WHERE MBR_CD = #{mbrCd} ORDER BY DUE_DATE DESC
